title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten documented, purchase-free Chico State activities, including student spaces, museums, galleries, workshops, and an arranged farm tour.

cards.title: Reset Together at The Well
cards.subtitle: Free wellness activities in Bell Memorial Union
cards.notes: Bring your Wildcat ID, meet friends inside the BMU, and choose a meditation, creative activity, sensory break, or quiet recharge.
cards.short_summary: A student-funded wellness space with drop-in rooms and more than 200 programs each semester.
cards.evidence_claim: The Well states that its drop-in spaces and more than 200 semester programs are free for currently enrolled Chico State students.
cards.source_title: The Well | Associated Students of CSU, Chico
cards.access_notes: Available without an additional purchase to current regularly enrolled Chico State students; faculty and staff need a paid WREC/Well membership.

cards.title: Compare Notes at Gateway Science Museum
cards.subtitle: Student admission-free science exhibits at 625 Esplanade
cards.notes: Bring your student identification, explore the regional science displays as a group, and leave time to compare discoveries afterward.
cards.short_summary: A compact science-museum outing where eligible students can explore without buying admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Gateway Science Museum lists free admission for Chico State and Butte College students.
cards.source_title: Visiting Gateway – Gateway Science Museum – Chico State
cards.access_notes: Free admission is limited to Chico State and Butte College students; visit during the museum's posted public hours and confirm the current schedule.

cards.title: Trade Perspectives at Headley Gallery
cards.subtitle: Admission-free art viewing in Arts & Humanities 121
cards.notes: Meet inside Arts and Humanities, view the current installation at your own pace, then regroup outside to discuss one memorable work.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gallery meetup centered on rotating university art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State's 2026 annual-exhibitions announcement identifies Jacki Headley University Art Gallery as a participating venue and states admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Annual Student Exhibitions Now On View! — Chico State
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; verify that an exhibition is on view and check current gallery hours before visiting.

cards.title: Browse A Gallery with a Friend
cards.subtitle: A free exhibition stop in Arts & Humanities 122
cards.notes: Choose a few works to examine separately, meet back near the entrance, and share what caught your attention without rushing the room.
cards.short_summary: A small campus gallery suited to a conversational, purchase-free art break.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State's 2026 annual-exhibitions announcement names A Gallery as an exhibition venue and states admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Annual Student Exhibitions Now On View! — Chico State
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; confirm that the gallery has an active exhibition and review current access hours before setting out.

cards.title: Look Closely at the Turner
cards.subtitle: Free print exhibitions in Arts & Humanities 123
cards.notes: Walk through the print exhibition together, pause over technique and detail, and check the museum's event page for a free public program.
cards.short_summary: A focused museum visit built around fine-art prints and occasional public activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State's 2026 annual-exhibitions announcement names The Janet Turner Print Museum and states admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Annual Student Exhibitions Now On View! — Chico State
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; check the museum's current exhibition and event calendar before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Valene L. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.title: Explore Culture at the Smith Museum
cards.subtitle: Free admission in Meriam Library 180
cards.notes: Visit with a classmate, follow the exhibition's cultural context carefully, and use the displayed prompts to start a thoughtful conversation.
cards.short_summary: An admission-free teaching museum presenting anthropology through student and faculty exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum's official visitor page states that admission is free and locates it in Meriam Library 180.
cards.source_title: Valene L. Smith Museum of Anthropology — Chico State
cards.access_notes: Free admission is available during posted museum hours; check the official page for current openings before arriving.

cards.title: Build a Group Study Session
cards.subtitle: Free resources and shared study space on campus
cards.notes: Pick a shared study area, bring the materials your group needs, and use the library's physical or digital resources to keep everyone moving.
cards.short_summary: A practical campus meetup combining conversation, study space, and library materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State's student-resources directory says Meriam Library provides free access to physical and digital resources plus individual and group study spaces.
cards.source_title: Find a Resource or Service – Student Resources and Services – Chico State
cards.access_notes: Free library resources and study spaces are described for students; follow posted building hours and borrowing eligibility rules.

cards.entity_name: The Hub at Éstom Jámani Courtyard
cards.title: Catch a Free Hub Activity
cards.subtitle: Housing-resident games, crafts, and movie meetups
cards.notes: Check the Housing schedule, invite another resident, and arrive for a listed craft, game, or movie activity without planning a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A residence-life gathering space with games and documented free programming.
cards.evidence_claim: University Housing says The Hub offers many free events, including arts and crafts opportunities and Friday Late Night in the Hub programs.
cards.source_title: The Hub – University Housing – Chico State
cards.access_notes: The Hub is described as a University Housing common space for residents; verify the current program schedule and resident access requirements.

cards.title: Learn an Outdoor Skill Together
cards.subtitle: Free workshops, events, and clinics through Adventure Outings
cards.notes: Scan the current Adventure Outings calendar, choose an event explicitly marked free, and confirm any registration or equipment requirements.
cards.short_summary: A rotating way to practice outdoor skills with others without paying a program fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Adventure Outings states that it offers a variety of free workshops, events, and clinics.
cards.source_title: Adventure Outings | Associated Students of CSU, Chico
cards.access_notes: Only attend offerings currently identified as free; check the official listing for eligibility, registration, age, and equipment requirements.

cards.entity_name: Paul L. Byrne Memorial University Farm
cards.title: Arrange a Group Farm Tour
cards.subtitle: A no-cost scheduled visit at 311 Nicholas C Schouten Lane
cards.notes: Organize the group in advance, request a tour through the Farm Office, wear closed-toe shoes, and follow staff directions throughout the visit.
cards.short_summary: An arranged educational outing through Chico State's working agricultural laboratory.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Farm's official visitor FAQ states there is no cost to tour the farm.
cards.access_notes: Tours require advance coordination and visitor check-in; self-guided visits are prohibited, and photography may require staff permission.
